name: College Park Mall
summary: College Park Mall is Corsicana's main enclosed shopping center, offering residents a diverse selection of retail stores and dining options with highly-rated customer service. With over 600 positive reviews averaging 4.2 stars, this community-focused mall serves as the primary retail destination for Navarro County.
demographics: College Park Mall serves the Corsicana, Texas community and surrounding Navarro County area, drawing primarily middle-income families and value-conscious shoppers. The trade area includes a mix of working-class households, retirees, and college-age residents from nearby Navarro College. Typical visitors range from young families seeking affordable retail options to older adults shopping for everyday necessities, with household incomes generally below the national median reflecting the rural Texas market characteristics.
description: College Park Mall stands as Corsicana's primary enclosed shopping destination, serving the community at 3500 West 7th Avenue since its establishment. This regional mall provides residents of Navarro County and surrounding areas with convenient access to a variety of retail stores, dining options, and services all under one roof. With a strong 4.2-star rating from over 600 reviews, shoppers consistently praise the mall's wonderful staff, quality merchandise selection, and great customer service. The center offers ample parking and climate-controlled shopping, making it an ideal destination year-round for families and individuals seeking both necessity items and leisure shopping experiences. As a cornerstone of retail activity in Corsicana, College Park Mall continues to serve as a community gathering place where locals can shop, dine, and socialize in a welcoming environment.
